```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN (ol.line_total - COALESCE(ol.discount_amount, 0)) - (ol.quantity * m.standard_cost_nzd) ELSE 0 END) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN (ol.line_total - COALESCE(ol.discount_amount, 0)) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines ol
JOIN staging.stg_ecom__orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON ol.sku = m.sku
WHERE o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
  AND m.product_category = 'Kitchen Tools';
```
